headline.text: L3 PTL 2 plastic bearing fell into *chocolate* during Hershey chip grid removal — tank drained to recover piece.

summary: One active hold — L2 ML3 awaiting supplier COA clearance to start. Three foreign-material finds at L1: washer on S2 return conveyor, missing washer/nut on S2 bolt, rip on S4 speeding table. L2 sorter failed allergen test; Level 4 clean continues Tuesday.

holds.title: ML3 line held pending ingredient COA
holds.summary: ML3 startup delayed awaiting written COA clearance from Bequet for ingredient; line expected to remain down until Tuesday.
holds.status: On hold — decision made to wait for COA clearance rather than quarantine finished goods.

food_safety.title: Washer found on S2 return conveyor 1
food_safety.summary: Employee inspecting product on S2 return conveyor 1 found a washer; QA notified, maintenance requested to inspect tunnel 2 section.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance inspection ongoing as of 18:22 to locate source and confirm no other hardware missing.

food_safety.title: S2 tunnel bolt missing washer and nut
food_safety.summary: Bolt on west side of S2 found missing washer and nut; nut believed to be on floor if anywhere.
food_safety.status: Open — floor search and equipment inspection in progress; no report of nut recovered.

food_safety.title: Plastic bearing fell into chocolate on PTL 2
food_safety.summary: Bearing dislodged during Hershey chip grid removal on PTL 2; chocolate drained into bins to recover the piece.
food_safety.status: Resolved — chocolate drained and bearing recovered; no report of pieces entering product stream.

food_safety.title: Rip found on S4 speeding table
food_safety.summary: Tear discovered on S4 speeding table during cleaning; potential for belt fragments to contact product.
food_safety.status: Open — reported during cleaning; no disposition or repair plan posted by window close.

quality.title: ML4 weights high, demolding issues
quality.summary: Bar weights above target on capture test; 10 totes of dirty molds rejected due to demolding failures throughout 3rd shift.
quality.status: Resolved — final refrigerator temperature lowered from 56.8°F to 53°F; demolding improved, mold rejections stopped by 06:57.

quality.title: ML4 Layer 2 and 3 weights out of range
quality.summary: Depositor layer weights for Layer 2 and Layer 3 both out of spec during first-shift morning checks.
quality.status: Resolved — operator and lead corrected settings; final bar weight and organoleptic passed at 08:13.

sanitation.title: S3 metal detector hard to clean without disassembly
sanitation.summary: S3 metal detector has multiple areas impossible to clean without removing covers; sanitation team flagged gaps during changeover.
sanitation.status: Resolved per shift — team cleaned accessible areas; supervisor advised to do best possible and retest ATP.

allergen.title: Panning sorter failed allergen testing
allergen.summary: Sorter could not pass allergen verification after Level 4 clean attempt; cleaning deferred to continue Tuesday.
allergen.status: Open — Level 4 clean incomplete; sorter remains down pending successful allergen test Tuesday.

opportunities.text: Consider adding hardware-integrity checks to S2 tunnel pre-start inspections — today's two separate fastener events (washer on conveyor, missing bolt hardware) suggest systematic vibration or assembly gaps.
Consider scheduling allergen-clean dry runs during slower weeks — today's sorter failure to pass after Level 4 clean cost a full line day and points to procedure or equipment design issues.
Review PTL grid-removal procedure for securing loose components — today's bearing drop into chocolate echoes the need for contained workspaces during ingredient-change tasks.
